{{Quote|They made a mistake. A man who was just released on four ended up back on two the next day. Word got out on the floor, and then they killed them all.|Rhasiv, to Kino Loy and Cassian Andor|<ref name="Nobody's Listening" />}}
A [[Gender|male]] '''prisoner''' of the [[Galactic Empire]] was held in the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|prison]] on the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]], where [[Prisoner|inmates]] produced machinery for the Empire. At the end of his sentence in [[5 BBY]], the prisoner was not freed but instead transferred to a [[Level 2 (Narkina 5)|different level]] of the facility the next [[Standard day|day]]. Word spread around their new [[Unit two-five|unit]] about the transfer, so the Imperial staff had the entire unit [[Death|killed]]. However, that did not stop the rumors from reaching other units, and one [[Unit Five-Two-D|unit shift]] started an [[Narkina 5 prison escape|uprising]] as a result that led to the freeing of all the prison's inmates.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Kino Loy|If he was released…|Rhasiv|You heard me.|Cassian Andor|No one's getting out, are they?|Rhasiv|Not now. Not after this.|attr=Kino Loy, Rhasiv, and Cassian Andor discuss the implications of the prisoner's transfer and death|src=<ref name="Nobody's Listening" />}}
[[File:Narkina_5_workroom.png|thumb|left|300px|The man was imprisoned at the Imperial facility on Narkina 5 (pictured).]]
During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], a [[Gender|male]] individual served a sentence in the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Imperial prison facility]] on<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> the [[moon]]<ref name="Narkina 5 AD">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> [[Narkina 5]]. At the [[prison]], the [[Prisoner|inmates]] operated an assembly line for<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> complex machinery<ref name="Ham DB">{{Databank|ham|Ham}}</ref> that would eventually be used in the construction of<ref name="Rix Road">{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}}</ref> the Empire's secret [[superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]].<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> The Imperial prisoner worked on [[Level 4 (Narkina 5)|Level 4]] of the facility until his sentence ended<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> at some point in [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> However, instead of being set free, he was transferred to [[unit two-five]] on [[Level 2 (Narkina 5)|Level 2]] the following [[Standard day|day]], a mistake by the Imperial staff.<ref name="Nobody's Listening" />

Word soon spread throughout unit two-five about the prisoner's transfer, so during a transfer between the day shift and the night shift of the unit, the Imperial commanders had the entire unit, including the prisoner, [[Death|killed]] by electrocution<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> using the conductive [[tunqstoid steel]] floors.<ref name="Narkina 5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> At that [[time]], the other units' shift changes were delayed because of the incident, and inmates spread word by [[sign language]] that something was happening on Level 2. The execution caused a brief power outage across the prison during the delay, and word soon spread afterwards about the fatalities, with one maintenance [[technician]] telling the [[floor manager]] [[Zinska]] about the deaths.<ref name="Nobody's Listening" />

[[File:Rhasiv-explains.png|thumb|right|300px|Rhasiv told Kino Loy about the Empire's mistake with the prisoner.]]
The inmate medical technician [[Doctor]] [[Rhasiv]] learned of the Empire's mistake and the resulting massacre, passing the news to floor manager [[Kino Loy]] and the inmate [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] on [[Level 5 (Narkina 5)|Level 5]]. Realizing that it meant they would never be released,<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> the pair led their [[Unit Five-Two-D|unit shift]] in an [[Narkina 5 prison escape|uprising]] against the Imperial staff, successfully taking control of the [[Command center (Narkina 5)|command center]] and freeing the rest of the prisoners in the facility.<ref name="One Way Out">{{Andor|One Way Out}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial prisoner was first mentioned in "[[Nobody's Listening!]]," the ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> which aired on [[November 2]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref>
